description: This source file implements the StringCodec class, which provides serialization and deserialization logic for strings within the Orleans serialization framework. It handles reading and writing string data with UTF-8 encoding, including reference handling, multi-segment reading, and efficient buffer management.

classes.name: StringCodec
classes.description: A sealed serializer class for handling UTF-8 string serialization, conforming to the IFieldCodec<string> interface within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a string value from the provided reader, handling reference resolution and wire type enforcement.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads raw string content given the number of bytes, either directly or via multi-segment reading.

methods.name: ReadMultiSegment
methods.description: Handles reading string data spanning multiple segments from the reader.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a string value, including reference handling and writing UTF-8 encoded data with length prefix.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes a string's UTF-8 encoded bytes into the buffer, choosing between contiguous or multi-segment write based on size.

methods.name: WriteMultiSegment
methods.description: Handles encoding and writing string data across multiple buffer segments efficiently.
